notes.descriptionPoeEquipment:
Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.
Bow: You want the highest dps ele/phys weapon you can afford. [Obliterator Bow] is usually the go to, as it has very high base damage and the downside is negligible.  Check the notes at the bottom of the guide to learn how to craft a bow. Before you have access to [Obliterator Bow], just use the highest DPS bow you find on the ground or can trade for.
[Greater Iron Rune] will provide the highest dps.
Quiver: Just good dps stats, high flat/bow dmg or projectile speed with attack speed. Ideally just aim for 3-4 stats from the quiver I'm showing in the gear preview.
amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 30 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems.
Helmet: At the start just look for a high life/evasion/resist helmet, eventually we'll swap to a pure ES helmet with [Subterfuge Mask], but you probably wont have a good one for early mapping.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with [Beastial Skin] on the passive tree. use [Greater Iron Rune]
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a [Headhunter].
Rarity is still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)
Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want [Heart of the Well] with double "gain as extra" and [Against the Darkness] with double again as extra as well.
important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having [Mark of Siphoning II] on [Freezing Mark] with [Eternal Mark] should give you enough sustain.
Anoint:
Damage: [Serrated Edges]
This is just a cheap anoint and pretty effective when you eventually swap to crit.
notes.descriptionPoeSkillGems:
The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.
6 Link Priority: [Snipe] -> [Ice Shot] -> [Herald of Ice] -> [Freezing Mark]
Quality Priority:  [Freezing Mark] -> [Herald of Ice] -> [Snipe] -> [Ice Shot]
Don't use [Elemental Armament III], only level 2.
If you don't have the spirit or want to drop it, the spirit [Mirage Archer] can be dropped for [Wind Dancer](link with [Blind II] and [Knockback]).
Early mapping gameplay:
You want to keep the buff from [Freezing Mark] up, has a 20 second duration. Besides that you're just using Ice shot, [Snipe] is only for map bosses. Optional: use [Ice-Tipped Arrows]
Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a [Barrage] [Snipe] combo.
Pre-place [Tornado Shot], cast [Ice-Tipped Arrows], spam [Ice Shot] until the boss is frozen. Use [Barrage] into [Snipe]. Make sure you still have a [Tornado Shot] down before casting barrage/snipe.
Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and [Freezing Mark] on weapon set 2.
notes.descriptionPoe2PassiveTree:
Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything. You should also lookout for good attribute amulets or a strength belt to help out with requirements later on.
This is a level 75 tree, while you should be entering maps around lvl 60-65, just fill out the nodes as you go. If you need defense start taking the evasion/deflection nodes, otherwise just keep clicking the damage nodes.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take [Feathered Fletching]
Ascendancy order:
[Projectile Proximity Specialisation](point blank) -> [Endless Munitions] -> [Gathering Winds] -> [Mirage Deadeye]
Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and [Freezing Mark] on weapon set 2.

richTextSections.title: Build Overview
richTextSections.text:
This is my Endgame Guide for [Ice Shot]. The build has amazing clear and very strong boss damage with [Snipe], with good gear you're one shotting all bosses. Eventually with enough gear, you can also drop [Snipe] and become a 1 button mapping and bossing build. Easily the best bow build in 0.5
For the Leveling Guide, check the link below.
Leveling Guide: mobalytics.gg/poe-2/profile/fubgun/builds/0-5-ice-shot-deadeye-leveling-guide

richTextSections.title: How it Plays
richTextSections.text:
Quest Rewards in Campaign
1) Act 2 - Medallion: Increase charm charges gained
2) Act 3 - Venom reward - Stun threshold
3) Tattoo Act 4 - Dex/Lightning resist/Fire resist
4) Act 4 Prison - Life recovery from flask
5) Interlude - Can choose Resist, MS or global defense (it's free to change at anytime, so don't stress)

Gear Progression:
1) Fully setup non-crit setup, I would prio a headhunter before swapping to crit
(have heart of the well, cheap for a lot of extra damage/3 prop jewels).
2) Focus on a really good Crit bow and Crit quiver before swapping to crit
3) Big evasion chest is massive for defense
4) Aim for a 450~ ES helmet when swapping to hybrid
5) After that I would focus on Solid boots/gloves/rings/amulet (+2 proj/spirit on amulet)
6) Get against the darkness with as extra cold (eventually double as extra).
Low priority (too expensive to justify the power they give at the moment, buy if you have currency).
[Rakiata's Flow]/[Dialla's Desire]/[Rite of Passage]
These are solid upgrades, but not priority over the above.
